title: Wife's matching dream of number cubes at Schwandorf church
summary: Rolf Mowatt-Larssen tells of Wife's matching dream of number cubes at Schwandorf church, about 1978 at Schwandorf, Germany, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: and as I came approached the end, dim light, just some lights on the church on the side, I saw your desk.

plain: Rolf Mowatt-Larssen, a former CIA officer, tells podcast host Jesse Michels that in 1978 in Schwandorf, Germany, his wife had a dream that matched his own dream of cubes covered in numbers at a church. He says she described walking up in dim light, with only a few lights on the side of the church, and seeing his desk. Shared dreams like this, if true, would suggest two minds can reach the same place in sleep.
